"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/jewels-and-stones/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

771. Jewels and Stones

You're given strings jewels representing the types of stones that are jewels, and stones representing the stones you have. Each character in stones is a type of stone you have. You want to know how many of the stones you have are also jewels.

Letters are case sensitive, so "a" is considered a different type of stone from "A".

Example 1:

Input: jewels = "aA", stones = "aAAbbbb"
Output: 3

Example 2:

Input: jewels = "z", stones = "ZZ"
Output: 0

Constraints:

    1 <= jewels.length, stones.length <= 50
    jewels and stones consist of only English letters.
    All the characters of jewels are unique.
"""


class Solution:
    def numJewelsInStones(self, jewels: str, stones: str) -> int:
        jewel_set = set(jewels)
        count = 0
        for stone in stones:
            if stone in jewel_set:
                count += 1
        return count


sol = Solution()

print(sol.numJewelsInStones("aA", "aAAbbbb"))  # 3

assert sol.numJewelsInStones("aA", "aAAbbbb") == 3
assert sol.numJewelsInStones("z", "ZZ") == 0

assert sol.numJewelsInStones("", "") == 0
assert sol.numJewelsInStones("a", "") == 0
assert sol.numJewelsInStones("", "a") == 0
assert sol.numJewelsInStones("a", "a") == 1
assert sol.numJewelsInStones("a", "A") == 0
assert sol.numJewelsInStones("A", "a") == 0
assert sol.numJewelsInStones("abc", "abcabcabc") == 9
assert sol.numJewelsInStones("abc", "xyzxyzxyz") == 0
assert (
    sol.numJewelsInStones("aA", "aAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAaAa")
    == 49
)
assert (
    sol.numJewelsInStones(
        "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ",
        "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ",
    )
    == 52
)
assert (
    sol.numJewelsInStones("a", "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa")
    == 50
)
assert (
    sol.numJewelsInStones("zZ", "zzZZzzZZzzZZzzZZzzZZzzZZzzZZzzZZzzZZzzZZzzZZzzZZ")
    == 48
)
